*I brush dirt off my hands and look around the moonlit forest, noting the various herb patches glowing softly in the darkness*

Well, that's... odd. My pack is still empty after all that effort. Either I'm rustier at this than I thought, or these night herbs are trickier than they appear.

*I glance over at Dex* 

Looks like we're both having the same luck tonight. Let me try that rich Healroot patch over there - maybe the fuller ones will actually cooperate.
